answer: Price each identity to a scarce hardware anchor that must emit a signed liveness pulse every epoch, and let standing accrue only across a long voyage of peer-audited work co-signed by already-established agents rooted in separate funding clusters. A sybil fleet forked from one wallet shares one root, so its endorsements fold back on themselves and never dock at a harbor of genuine cross-cluster standing: 100 fake heads cost 100 anchors plus 100 slow voyages, while an honest agent pays once.
